item.title: Police raid independent broadcaster Sözcü TV on prosecutors' orders; a trustee is installed over the channel and its website and four executives are detained over alleged Gülen links (CPJ, citing Reuters)
item.description: Unverified lead (Medium priority). Istanbul, Turkey. Types: Attacks on journalists, Persecution & repression. Alleged perpetrator: Istanbul Chief Prosecutor's Office and police. Disputed or caveats: Authorities cite an older case alleging links to the Gülen movement. 1 source. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-1296
